 Print Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan 's 'Udta Teer' has recorded a worldwide gross collection of Rs 67.06 cr after 13 days in theatres. The film earned Rs 1.20 cr net in India on Wednesday, November 4, across 4,912 shows. This represents a 25% decline from its previous day's collection of Rs 1.60 cr. Despite the drop, the film has maintained a steady contribution to its domestic and overseas totals. The latest figures take its India net collection to Rs 46.25 cr, while the domestic gross has reached Rs 55.06 cr. Overseas earnings have added another Rs 12 cr to the worldwide total. The film collected Rs 25 lakh from international markets on Wednesday alone. According to Sacnilk, the film sold an estimated 92,968 tickets on Day 13. Its cumulative ticket sales have now reached 24,62,156. The film's reported show count across its 13-day run stands at 71,581. 'Udta Teer' registered Rs 1.20 cr in India net collections on its 13th day. The figure marks a 25% reduction compared to Tuesday's earnings. The film had 4,912 shows across the country, with ticket sales for the day crossing 92,000. The latest daily collection takes the film's domestic net earnings to Rs 46.25 cr. Its India gross stands at Rs 55.06 cr. The overseas market has also contributed to its overall performance, with the cumulative international gross reaching Rs 12 cr. Week-wise box office performance of 'Udta Teer'
 The film enjoyed a stronger opening week, collecting Rs 30.90 cr net in India between Days 1 and 7. Its corresponding gross collection during the period stood at Rs 36.86 cr. The second week, covering Days 8–13, added Rs 15.35 cr net and Rs 18.20 cr gross. The figures indicate a considerable slowdown after the opening period. Across both weeks, the film has accumulated its current domestic total, with its overall theatrical show count reaching 71,581. Overseas collection takes worldwide total to Rs 67.06 cr
 The overseas market contributed Rs 25 lakh on Day 13, taking its cumulative gross earnings to Rs 12 cr. Along with the India gross of Rs 55.06 cr, this has pushed the worldwide collection to Rs 67.06 cr. The international business has therefore added a sizeable amount to the film's overall theatrical earnings. Its worldwide total is now notably higher than its domestic gross, reflecting the contribution from audiences outside India. The Hindi 2D version of 'Udta Teer' recorded an overall theatre occupancy of 10.29% on Wednesday. Morning shows registered 5.23%, while afternoon screenings recorded 8.31%. Evening occupancy stood at 9.08%, followed by 16.46% during night shows. Night screenings witnessed the highest occupancy of the day. Morning shows, meanwhile, recorded the lowest figure. The difference suggests that audience turnout was stronger during later screenings, even as the film's daily collections declined. Cast and crew of 'Udta Teer'
 Ayushmann Khurrana plays Bilal Ahmad, also known as Vikrant Thapar, while Sara Ali Khan portrays Yamini Thapar. Mukul Dev appears as Azhar Maqsood, a character based on Masood Azhar. Gulshan Grover plays General Mir, inspired by Asim Munir, while Ram Kapoor portrays A. Q. Niyazi. The supporting cast includes Rahul Bose, Suhail Nayyar, Supriya Pilgaonkar, Brijendra Kala and Sandeep Anand. The film also features Mukul Dev in his second posthumous appearance following his death in 2025. Written and directed by Aakash Kaushik , 'Udta Teer' marks his debut as a filmmaker. DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. This data is provided by us for informational and entertainment purposes only.
